commands.label: Fixed Java caller compiled against official

limits: Bounded static source inline bodies, real JVM reification, parameter modes, direct lambda expansion and caller-side cleanup. Source body exception tables, captured/generated inline closures, receivers, defaults, varargs, complex reified bounds/classifiers remain explicit boundaries. Scalar Short is a prerequisite; ShortArray remains unsupported. No Android/full app or speed claim.
archival_scope: Original frozen source archives, text command evidence and source fixtures retained; compiler binaries and generated class/index files remain ignored.
scope: Isolated repair validation, not final combined v2 acceptance.
